chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Safwan from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Whoever begins with al-Marwah before al-Safa, let him discard what he has walked and begin with al-Safa before al-Marwah."

key_terms.الصَّفَا: Al-Safa, the starting point of the sa'i ritual
key_terms.الْمَرْوَةِ: Al-Marwah, the ending point of the sa'i ritual

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a pilgrim walks from Marwah to Safa first?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the procedural validity of Sa'i by establishing the starting point at al-Safa as a condition for correctness. It highlights the scholarly consensus that reversing the order—starting at al-Marwah—invalidates the ritual, requiring the pilgrim to discard the previous effort and restart from the beginning. This ruling underscores the importance of adhering to the Sunnah of the Prophet and the Imams in the precise execution of Hajj rites.
